title: A Guide to Painting Through Pain
description: Choe presents painting through pain as a sequence of tangents, naming deception, returning to the site of a wound, asking what protection was needed then and finally revealing the art show as a self-help exercise interrupted by his mother.
summary: Choe presents painting through pain as a sequence of tangents, naming deception, returning to the site of a wound, asking what protection was needed then and finally revealing the art show as a self-help exercise interrupted by his mother. This is an official-channel creative lesson or reflection, not clinical treatment or a universal formula. Its chronological map follows the route's own transcript and distinguishes art-making instructions from autobiographical claims, jokes and metaphors. Visually dependent technique still requires the source video.
